''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' establishes that the invasion happens in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. |date=[[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] |place=[[Naboo Resistance]] [[Naboo resistance base|outpost]][[Star Wars: Starfighter (video game)|''Star Wars: Starfighter'']] |result=*Resistance base protected *[[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Army B]] destroyed''[[The New Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]'' |side1=*[[Lok Revenants/Legends|Lok Revenants]] *[[Naboo Underground]] |side2=[[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] |side3= |side4= |commanders1=*[[Nym/Legends|Nym]] *A [[Unidentified Naboo resistance fighter|Naboo resistance fighter]] |commanders2= |commanders3= |commanders4= |unit1= |unit2= |unit3= |unit4= |forces1=*[[Havoc (starfighter)|''Havoc'']] *''[[Guardian Mantis]]'' *[[Bravo Squadron/Legends|Bravo Flight]] {{C|late battle}} *One [[N-1 starfighter/Legends|N-1 starfighter]] {{C|late battle}} *''[[Zoomer]]'' {{C|late battle}} *Resistance outpost **One [[V-19 landspeeder|Gian speeder]] **[[Laser cannon/Legends|Laser cannons]] **[[Deflector shield generator/Legends|Deflector shield generator]] |forces2=*Six [[Heavy Artillery Gun]]s *A number of [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|Armored Assault Tanks]] *Two [[C-9979 landing craft/Legends|C-9979 landing craft]] *Several [[Trade Federation Dropship]]s *A [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of [[Scarab-class starfighter/Legends|Scarab droid starfighters]] *A squadron of [[Trade Federation droid bomber]]s |forces3= |forces4= |casual1=None |casual2=*Heavy *All HAGs *All fighters *A number of AATs |casual3= |casual4= |civilian= }} {{Quote|Power up the guns; everyone take defensive positions.|The outpost commander|}} A '''battle''' took place around a [[Naboo Resistance|Naboo resistance]] base during the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation's]] [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invasion]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. It took place simultaneously with the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|battle]] raging on the [[Great Grass Plains/Legends|Great Grass Plains]]. The [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Trade Federation Droid Army]] sent three elements to the Plains; one engaged the [[Gungan Grand Army/Legends|Gungan Grand Army]] head-on, one [[Battle of the south ridge|flanked]] [[Theed/Legends|Theed's]] south ridge, and the third element flanked the plains and discovered a Naboo [[Naboo resistance base|Resistance outpost]]. The last element engaged the base, but was countered by the [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] [[Nym/Legends|Nym]] and [[Vana Sage]]. The two [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] joined with the [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] to defend the base and destroyed numerous vehicles. The battle dragged on, but the two spacers were joined by [[Bravo Squadron/Legends|Bravo Flight]] pilot [[Rhys Dallows]] and the [[Toydarian/Legends|Toydarian]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Reti]]. With a reinforced squadron, Nym was able to fight off the rest of the [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|battle droids]]. Destroying an element of the [[Droid/Legends|Droid]] [[Army/Legends|Army]] allowed the Grand Army to hold out while Bravo Flight destroyed the [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|Lucrehulk-class Droid Control Ship]] in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] and ended the invasion. ==Prelude== The [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invaded]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] in response to taxation of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim trade routes]]. The [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] became embroiled in a desperate battle for their [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. The [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] fled to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to find a way to end the invasion in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] but returned home to [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|free the planet]]. She planned on using [[Gungan Grand Army/Legends|Gungan Grand Army]] to draw out the main part of the [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Trade Federation Droid Army]] while the she led a ground assault of the capital [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]]. The Trade Federation sent three [[Army/Legends|armies]] to engage the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]]. Army A engaged the Gungan army head-on, [[Army B]] flanked from the side of the Plains, and [[Army C]] [[Battle of the south ridge|approached]] from the [[south ridge of Theed]]. Army B discovered a [[Naboo resistance base|Resistance outpost]] on the Plains and engaged it. The [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Nym/Legends|Nym]], after [[Battle of Lok (32 BBY)|losing]] his base to the Trade Federation, agreed to join forces with the [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo resistance]] and engaged Army B. ==The battle== [[File:SWS_HAG.jpg|thumb|left|200px|A Heavy Artillery Gun, Nym's primary target during the battle.]] {{Quote|Nym! We're outnumbered!''"
"''Then we fight to the end.|Vana Sage and Nym during the battle|}} A [[Scout/Legends|scout]] found the approaching Army B and raced back to warn the base. The [[Unidentified Naboo resistance fighter|outpost commander]] ordered the outpost to prepare for battle. The Federation deployed [[Heavy Artillery Gun]]s to engage the outpost. The resistance's [[Laser turret/Legends|laser turrets]] opened fire on the [[Tank/Legends|tanks]]. The [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] Nym and [[Vana Sage]] were flying overhead searching for the Federation army, so the commander contacted them and asked them to protect the outpost. Nym used the [[Bomblet generator/Legends|Bomblet generator]] on his [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]], the [[Havoc (starfighter)|''Havoc'']] to take out the enemy [[Artillery/Legends|artillery]]. The outpost commander kept up a running commentary as Nym attacked the tanks. While Nym was attacking the HAGs, two Federation [[C-9979 landing craft/Legends|C-9979 landing craft]] and several [[Trade Federation Dropship|dropships]] landed and disgorged a number of [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|Armored Assault Tanks]] to attack the outpost. A [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] of [[Scarab-class starfighter/Legends|Scarab droid starfighters]] arrived to support the tanks. Sage engaged the fighters in her personal fighter, the ''[[Guardian Mantis]]''. Even though the first wave was destroyed, more [[Droid/Legends|droid]] starfighters and a squad of [[Trade Federation droid bomber|droid bombers]] joined the fight. Sage commented to Nym that they were outnumbered, but Nym was determined to fight to the end. Nym's wingmate and [[Bravo Squadron/Legends|Bravo Flight]] pilot [[Rhys Dallows]] as well as the [[Toydarian/Legends|Toydarian]] [[Reti]] arrived at that moment to support the Naboo outpost. Nym told them to attack anything that moved. With a reinforced squadron, Nym was able to fight off the rest of the Federation forces and save the outpost from destruction. The outpost commander thanked the pilots as they flew off. ==Aftermath== As a third of the Federation army had been destroyed at the outpost, and another third destroyed by [[Gavyn Sykes/Legends|Gavyn Sykes]] at the south ridge of Theed, the Gungans were able to hold out long enough for the Naboo Security Forces to infiltrate Theed. With the [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|''Lucrehulk''-class Droid Control Ship]] ship in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] destroyed, the invasion ended with the capture of [[Viceroy/Legends|Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]]. ==Behind the scenes== This battle appeared in the [[2001]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: Starfighter (video game)|''Star Wars: Starfighter'']] mission "Last Stand on Naboo" and was mentioned in the Gungan civilization DataBank entry in the video game ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'', released later that year. The event was later given an indirect mention when describing a diagram of the Battle of Grassy Plains in ''[[The New Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''. ==Appearances== *''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'' {{C|Gungan civilization DataBank entry}} {{Mo}} *[[Star Wars: Starfighter (video game)|''Star Wars: Starfighter'']] {{1st}} *[[Starfighter: Crossbones 1|''Starfighter: Crossbones'' 1]] {{Flash}} *''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Clone Campaigns]]'' {{C|Gungan civilization DataBank entry}} {{Mo}} ==Sources== *[[Star Wars: Starfighter: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: Starfighter'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]] *''[[The New Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]'' {{Imo}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{LegendsNabooCrisisNav}} {{Interlang |es=Batalla de la Base de la Resistencia de Naboo }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Naboo resistance base, battle of the}} [[Category:Battles of the Invasion of Naboo]]
